# Psalm 135 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Hallelujah! Praise the LORD's name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD —

**2** you who serve in the LORD's house, in the courtyards of our God's temple!

**3** Praise the LORD because he is good! Sing praises to his name because it is beautiful!

**4** The LORD chose Jacob for himself — Israel as his prized possession.

**5** I know for a fact that the LORD is great — our Lord is greater than every other god.

**6** The LORD does whatever he wants — in heaven, on earth, in the seas, and in their depths.

**7** He makes the clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain. He releases the wind from his warehouses.

**8** He struck down Egypt's firstborn — both people and animals.

**9** He sent miraculous signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt — against Pharaoh and all who served him.

**10** He defeated many nations and killed powerful kings —

**11** Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and every kingdom in Canaan —

**12** and gave their land as an inheritance — an inheritance to his people Israel.

**13** LORD, your name lasts forever! LORD, your fame continues through every generation.

**14** The LORD will defend his people and show compassion to those who serve him.

**15** The idols of the nations are just silver and gold — things made by human hands.

**16** They have mouths but can't talk; eyes but can't see.

**17** They have ears but can't hear; there's not even a breath in their mouths.

**18** The people who make them will end up just like them — so will everyone who trusts in them.

**19** People of Israel, praise the LORD! Descendants of Aaron, praise the LORD!

**20** Descendants of Levi, praise the LORD! All who honor the LORD, praise him!

**21** Praise the LORD from Zion — the LORD who lives in Jerusalem! Hallelujah!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **135:6**: 'The LORD does whatever he wants — in heaven, on earth, in the seas.' That's sovereignty in one sentence. There is no domain where God's authority doesn't reach.

- **135:15-18**: Same idol takedown as Psalm 115 — they can't see, hear, speak, or breathe. And the people who make them become equally lifeless. It's worth repeating because idolatry is always a temptation.

— PNEUMA
